headline: Kimchi recently dropped his first YouTube video, giving viewers a closer look at his lifes
body: Kimchi recently dropped his first YouTube video, giving viewers a closer look at his lifestyle, from flying on private jets to hanging out with familiar faces across music, sports, and entertainment. Kimchi, who has kept a relatively low profile online, is now giving the public a glimpse into his world. via.
